A '''duel''' took place at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy]] in [[3645 BBY]] when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Scabrous]] attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Hestizo Trace]] and eat her [[Heart/Legends|heart]] in order to grant himself eternal life with the assistance of a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]] he engineered.<ref name="Red Harvest" />
